reviews.name: Dattatraya R. Patil
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this car accessories shop. I got a 70mai dashcam, damping, premium seat covers, Blaupunkt Velocity Series infotainment system, Morel speakers, a 360° camera, Kovalent Borophene coating, and window film installed for my Hyundai Creta.

The entire team was highly professional, knowledgeable, and patient in explaining every product. The installation quality was neat, clean, and completed with great attention to detail. All the accessories were fitted perfectly, and the finish looks completely factory-installed.

The staff delivered everything on time and provided excellent after-sales support. I'm extremely satisfied with the quality of the products and workmanship. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for premium car accessories and professional installation.

Special thanks to Mr. Akshay and all staff.

reviews.name: Prajwal
reviews.text:
I recently visited Jay Ganesh Car Accessories (Loni Kalbhor) and must say I’m thoroughly impressed. The store carries a wide and thoughtful range of high‑quality car accessories, from seat‑covers and mats to sound systems and coating kits, which made it very easy to find exactly what I was looking for.
What really stood out was the staff’s attitude: they were friendly, knowledgeable and took the time to understand my requirements before recommending products. Their installation process was smooth and efficient, and I appreciated that they explained options rather than pushing upsells.
Pricing was fair, and the value for money felt good— I got premium accessories without feeling over‑charged. Overall, the experience was far above what I had expected. I’d highly recommend Jay Ganesh Car Accessories to anyone looking to upgrade their vehicle with trusted accessories and smooth service.
